sourceFindings.reason: WooCommerce full_src width960 height720 is the actual960×720 JPEG, not just a thumbnail. Named poplar in assorted cuts cannot establish the wood species of ATEHNA records that omit it.
Indexed22_1_pdf.pdf catalogue lists250×500mm poplar3/4mm; current host is only a placeholder with an embedded554×300 image. No current native product photograph could be recovered.

Followed the actual catalogue from the successful v8 source. Its10 beech offerings do not include4×250×250 or6×400×300. The already accepted4×500×500 photo is not remapped to a smaller square. Several4mm formats resemble unspecified-species ATEHNA sizes, but no independent evidence establishes those records as beech.
New supplier lists2520×1720 poplar stock. Untouched WordPress JPEG is899×547 and shows a cropped corner; unsuitable as whole main.

Technical sheet identifies2520×1720 poplar among standard formats. The former guessed product route returned404; public site search returned no usable product photo. New S3/CDN host references were followed without locating an exact photographic gallery.

Current manufacturer product gallery supplies1920×774,900×1964,600×600 and400×600 originals. Every original has at least one axis below1024. Gallery also lacks thickness-specific identification for the pictured panels; no source image enlarged.

Exact6×2520×1720 poplar entry9739 resolved via product page and untransformed UNAS shop_pic original. WebP and originalJPEG are both900×518; bypassing thumbnail transforms did not reveal a larger photograph.
Exact4×2520×1720 poplar page exists; current page has no product original distinct from navigation assets. Other product images were not substituted.

Shopify metadata explicitly labels the1164×1600 main as12mm Poplar Premium Plywood even when3mm or6mm is selected. This is a known thickness conflict, so it cannot be assigned to the exact3/4/6mm ATEHNA variants. Remaining originals are1024×576 or600×597.
Exact4mm beech cut-service page returns only default-bild placeholder assets, with no useful actual board photograph.
Lists poplar3/4/6/8/10mm and a700×500 working area, but public laser-service page does not expose a complete untreated exact board photo. Laser-cut examples cannot stand in for raw panels.
New current manufacturer host failed a plain public fetch; indexed2018 price list establishes stock types but not a qualifying original photograph.
